_note: Every reader-visible string, by key (crates/core/src/page.rs). Words follow GLOSSARY.md and TONE.md. Strings marked as copied in SECOND-ORDER.md come from CHUMWORLD unchanged.
title: Chumworld Arena
no_webgl: This game draws with WebGL 2, which this browser has turned off or does not have. Turn on hardware acceleration in the browser's settings, or open the page in a current Chrome, Firefox or Safari.
swing_how: Hold the left button and move the mouse sideways for a level cut, up or down for a chop or a rising cut. Turn the wheel away for a thrust. Hold the right button to guard. The view holds still while either button is held.
wound_take_up: X · Take up your sword in your other hand
title_text: A duel in a stone ring, seen from inside the helmet. Practice against the computer's knight, best of three rounds.
menu_text: Practice is a duel against the computer's knight, best of three rounds.
save_loaded: Save loaded. Your settings are the file's.
save_refused_file: That file was refused: {why} Your settings are as they were.
save_refused_stored: The save in this browser was refused: {why} The settings start from their defaults.
save_why_unreadable: it is not a save file.
save_why_format: it is a file of another kind, not this game's save.
save_why_version: it is from another version of the game.
save_why_checksum: it has been changed since it was written.
save_why_field: its "{field}" is not what a save holds.
sudden_death: Sudden death: stay inside the inner ring
fell_foe_sand: The {name} fell outside the inner ring.
fell_you_sand: You fell outside the inner ring.
fell_both: You and the {name} fell at once. The round is fought again.
online_menu_note: Host and Join meet another browser by room code. Pasted codes do the same with no relay, when the relays fail.
paste_text: One player hosts and sends an invitation; the other pastes it, makes a reply and sends it back. No relay is used.
host_room_text: Give the other player this room code, or send them the join link. They choose Join and type the code, or open the link and choose Join; the duel begins when they arrive. You are the black helm.
join_room_text: Type the room code the host gave you, then choose Join. You are the ivory crown.
join_link_text: The room code from your join link is filled in. Choose Join. You are the ivory crown.
paste_host_text: Send this invitation to the other player. Paste their reply below and choose Accept the reply. You are the black helm.
paste_join_text: Paste the host's invitation and choose Make a reply. Send the reply back to the host. You are the ivory crown.
online.playing: The other player is here. The duel is on.
online.reload: The other player's game is another version. Both reload the page, then try again.
online.garbled: A message from the other player could not be read. The duel goes on.
online.left: The other player left the duel.
online.full: That room already has two players. Try another room code.
online.desync: Desync: the two browsers' duels no longer agree, so the duel stops here. This is a fault in the game.
online.timeout: No word from the other player for {seconds} seconds, so the duel has ended.
online.no_bundle: The code for room codes did not load. Reload the page, or use pasted codes.
online.no_relay: No relay answered. Try again, or use pasted codes.
online.no_path: The two browsers found no way to reach each other: both networks block a direct link, and this game has no relay to carry a duel.
online.signal_failed: The two browsers could not finish meeting. Try again, or use pasted codes.
online.bad_code: That is not a code from this game. Paste the whole code the other player sent.
online.bad_room: A room code is five letters, such as KMRTW.
online.not_online: Choose Host or Join on the menu first.
online.rematch_wait: Waiting for the other player to choose Rematch.
key_feint: Right button, as a cut draws back
move_kick_lands: Kick lands: their guard is open
move_beaten: Beaten aside: your blade is out of line
ladder_text: {campaign.rungs} battles in {campaign.regions} regions. Each duel is best of three rounds. A battle opens when what it needs is won, and a region when the one before it holds enough marks. Beating an opponent gives its look, and its weapon if it carries a new one.
dossier_reward_text: Its look, to wear in Practice and the campaign
wears_squire: A padded coat, a mail hood and a broad-brimmed steel hat
wears_sellsword: A studded coat with plates inside, a tailed helm and one big plate on the right shoulder
wears_hedge: Half plate under a long torn surcoat, and a pointed helm
wears_veteran: Bare upper arms, one huge pauldron, a leather coat and a helm with a T-shaped face
wears_banneret: Fluted plate, a plumed helm, a blue tabard and a cape
wears_champion: Broad gilt tourney plate and a winged great helm
wears_mirror: Blackened plate with bright edges and a helm with no face
dossier_squire: Slow to see a cut coming and slow to answer it. He parries now and then, rarely presses, and backs off early as his stamina runs low.
dossier_sellsword: Cuts often and from either side, and guards carelessly. Now and then he answers a parry with a cut of his own.
dossier_hedge: Steady and patient. He parries more cuts than he misses, ripostes most parries, and kicks a guard held back too long.
dossier_veteran: A seasoned brawler: he kicks a waiting guard early, ripostes the moment he parries, and feints a chop now and then. Keep your guard moving.
dossier_banneret: Schooled. He parries most cuts, raises his guard against the rest, feints to draw your cut, and rests before he is winded.
dossier_champion: Quick and strong. He parries most plain cuts, ripostes at once, kicks a waiting guard and feints often.
dossier_mirror: Sees a cut almost as you begin it, parries most of what comes, and answers a parry at once. The last battle of the campaign.
earned_none: {what} is not won yet. Choose Rematch to fight it again.
earned_1: {what} won: one mark. Win it without losing a round for the second.
earned_2: {what} won without losing a round: both marks.
earned_look: {name}'s look is yours to wear: choose it under Your look in the settings.
look_not_won: That look is won in the campaign. Win its battle first.
watch_text: Two fighters duel on their own trees. Each rule's checks light up as the tree reads them, and the rule that ran is marked.
watch_overlay_on: Show each move over its fighter
watch_overlay_off: Hide the moves over the fighters
watch_tree_none: {name}'s tree: no rule ran, so the move under way goes on
watch_hint: Drag the view to circle the fighters; the wheel brings it closer. Space pauses, and the full stop steps one tick.
cond_tip_near_head: their point within {n} cm of my head
cond_swing_coming: a cut coming faster than {n} cm a second
cond_can_take_up: a hand free to take it up
cond_foe_turtles: foe has not cut for {n} ticks
wears_woodsman: Its own costume is still to be made; for now, the sellsword's
wears_friar: Its own costume is still to be made; for now, the squire's
wears_warden: Its own costume is still to be made; for now, the hedge knight's
wears_reiver: Its own costume is still to be made; for now, the veteran's
wears_pikeman: Its own costume is still to be made; for now, the banneret's
wears_headsman: Its own costume is still to be made; for now, the champion's
dossier_woodsman: Swings an axe that bites through plate. He kicks a guard held up, then steps in and cuts while you stagger.
dossier_friar: Holds his ground with a quarterstaff, either end striking. He parries, waits, and answers an open guard at once.
dossier_warden: Presses with a mace, one blow after another while his stamina lasts. A blunt blow dents plate but takes nothing off.
dossier_reiver: Feints with a broadsword until you parry at nothing, then makes the real cut.
dossier_pikeman: Keeps you at the end of a spear. He parries what reaches him and thrusts into an open guard.
dossier_headsman: A great axe in both hands, slow to start and heavy when it lands. He presses while he has the breath.
dossier_reward_weapon: Its look, and the {weapon} to hold
region_shut: Opens at {n} marks in {region}: {have} so far
weapon_not_won: That weapon is won in the campaign. Beat the opponent who carries it first.
earned_weapon: The {weapon} is yours to hold: choose it under Your weapon in the settings.
